comparison: imlunestrant plus abemaciclib versus imlunestrant monotherapy
clinical_limitation: ESR1-mutated 159-patient analysis is exploratory; overall-population PFS was statistically significant but no monotherapy PFS advantage demonstrated in ESR1m-not-detected population
l1_rationale: FDA EMBER-3 assessment reports PFS HR 0.53 (95% CI 0.35-0.80) in ESR1-mutated exploratory subgroup, median PFS 11.1 vs 5.5 months and ORR 35% vs 15%; companion diagnostic approved on same day; outcome already known and is not blind prediction.
major_risks: Exploratory subgroup; OS immature at 35% deaths; abemaciclib diarrhea/neutropenia/ILD/hepatotoxicity/VTE; independently verified NDA 218881/S-001 goal letter absent
remaining_blocker: Obtain original or amended goal date for NDA 218881/S-001 and avoid treating September 18 action date as proof of goal
